physicalNotes: Radius 0.9 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Anderson et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-105 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract): 626,130 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.89 +/- 0.09 solar masses from Anderson et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-105 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5070 +/- 130 K from Anderson et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-105 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...604A.110A/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
